H1.title: Linux desktop-package build breaks on the macOS-only TOC path
H1.resolution: libomp exclusion is now platform-aware (desktop_package.libomp_policy): macOS drops faiss/.dylibs, Linux drops nothing because auditwheel gives each wheel's libgomp a distinct mangled SONAME its own DT_NEEDED names, so the build no longer SystemExits at spec-eval off macOS; predicates stay directory-exact, all three guards preserved, marker doc and CLAUDE.md 4.5 amended

H2.title: Diff exceeds 400 LOC with allow_large_diff false
H2.resolution: Owner authorized allow_large_diff for m8 retroactively on 2026-08-10 and it is now recorded in state. The finding was correct: the orchestrator authorized the large diff for m7 only, never carried it forward, and omitted the scope gate from m8's dispatch prompt, so the implementer had no instruction to stop. Composition on the record: 3,132 of 4,059 insertions are the generated tests/fixtures/desktop_model/golden_v1.json; hand-written code and tests are approximately 927 lines.
